# Sneat Free

Source: https://github.com/themeselection/sneat-bootstrap-html-admin-template-free
Commit: de094c2bf89e602054b7c14f46c9a3a5b9f6cac9
License: MIT, included in LICENSE.

Official core and authentication styles are kept unmodified. The core includes Bootstrap styles. Riccati uses React for navigation, authentication and interactions; no template demo scripts, jQuery, analytics or demo accounts are included. Custom theme styles live in styles/sneat-riccati.css. Dark styling is a Riccati extension, not a Sneat Pro asset.
